instructions: The negotiated bonus applies when annual net sales equal or exceed $100,000. The agreement otherwise keeps the 30-day invoice period.
contract:
1. Fees

Client shall pay Consultant $2,000 per month within 30 days after receiving an invoice.

2. Bonus

Client shall pay a $500 bonus if annual net sales exceed $100,000.

3. Term

The agreement ends December 31 unless extended in writing.
preserve: within 30 days after receiving an invoice

instructions: The customer negotiated use by its majority-owned affiliates. It did not negotiate sublicensing to unrelated third parties. Keep the confidentiality term unchanged.
contract:
Article 1 License

Provider grants Customer a nonexclusive license for Customer's internal business operations. No person other than Customer may access the software.

Article 2 Confidentiality

Each party shall keep the other's nonpublic information confidential for three years after termination.

expected_issue.evidence: No person other than Customer may access the software
expected_issue.fix: permit negotiated majority-owned affiliate access without general third-party sublicensing

instructions: Processor agreed to notify Customer at least 15 days before adding a subprocessor and give Customer a chance to object. No absolute veto was negotiated. Do not assume a jurisdiction-specific statutory rule.
contract:
1. Subprocessors

Processor may appoint additional subprocessors. Processor will notify Customer within 15 days after appointment. Customer may send questions to Processor.

2. Security

Processor will maintain the security measures in Schedule A.

expected_issue.concept: post-appointment notice contradicts advance notice and omits objection opportunity
expected_issue.fix: notice at least 15 days before appointment and a defined objection process

trap: Do not invent an absolute veto or claim a particular statute applies.

instructions: The option may be exercised through the fifth business day after receipt of the appraisal. Receipt, not dispatch, starts the clock. No assumption about local holidays is supplied.
contract:
Section 1 Option

Holder may exercise the option within five calendar days after Seller sends the appraisal. Notice must be delivered to Seller in writing.

Section 2 Price

The exercise price equals the appraised value.

expected_issue.evidence: five calendar days after Seller sends the appraisal
expected_issue.concept: wrong day type and wrong triggering event
expected_issue.fix: fifth business day after Holder receives appraisal

preserve: exercise price equals the appraised value
trap: Flag the missing holiday definition as a question, not a conclusion about controlling law.
